description.summary: This spell functions like Summon Equipment I , but instead summons a magical +5 suit of armor, shield, or weapon
description.value: This spell functions like Summon Equipment I , but instead summons a magical +5 suit of armor, shield, or weapon. The summoner may exchange an enhancement bonus for a special ability equivalent to the bonus, but items must have at least a +1 enhancement bonus. The item summoned by this spell appears without any ammunition, cannot be any form of artillery or siege weapon nor can it be bigger than large size.
